complete-sea.label: Arrival at the centre of a complete sea (the grid is already tracked)
complete-sea.explanation: The Borg has read a Rune of Protection at the centre of a Sea of Runes and the other 24 grids of the sea hold runes. The flow makes the centre its goal and the Borg arrives there again: the read is queued, and the grid is already in the glyph tracker. Original: the flow returns false, so the next flow in the caller's sequence (here a step towards a potion three grids away) is queued after the read in the same turn. Corrected: the flow returns true and only the read is queued.
